candidates.title: Energy Data Dashboard Design — Real-Time Monitoring & Analytics
candidates.passReason: Warm dark brown/olive ground (#15120d territory), single amber accent applied only to active states and data markers, hairline-separated sections, dense instrument-panel layout with metric tiles and sparklines, monospace labels throughout, near-zero border radius on all panels, no multi-color accents. Terminal-frame embedded panel with minimal chrome has Almanac Noir DNA.
watchItems: Verify border-radius on metric cards is ≤3px (looked sharp at zoom)
Check whether accent is truly single-hue across full shot or has teal/blue secondary

candidates.title: Dark Amber UI Web User Interface Kit
candidates.passReason: Single amber accent (#f0a830 territory) against dark warm ground, typographic component kit showing header strips, badge/label patterns, and form controls. Header treatment includes horizontal brand cluster with mono badge + display-weight name. Hairline separators. Near-zero radius. Amber used only as active/accent state, not fill.
watchItems: Shot is older (2013) — verify the brand lockup pattern has the three-tier horizontal composition (mono chip + display wordmark + mono subtitle) rather than just a wordmark
Confirm no macOS-style colored traffic-light dots in terminal preview sections

candidates.title: Log Analyzer V2
candidates.passReason: Terminal/log output frame embedded inside a desktop app layout, dark background for output well darker than the chrome bar, monospace content throughout, minimal titlebar, no colorful traffic-light fills. Two-tone split (panel vs output well) is structurally the right pattern for terminal-preview reference.
watchItems: Titlebar may use macOS-style solid traffic lights — verify dots are muted/hollow rather than colored
Range slider in chrome bar: not confirmed present — may lack the inline col-width control
Warm vs cool: background may lean cooler than #15120d — borderline pass on palette
